'''Lessah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She worked as a Republic representative on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. When the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Senaru]] traveled to Taris hoping to analyze how the planet's wildlife had adapted to the post-[[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] ecosystem, Lessah served as his contact. Senaru believed that his research could help save his own planet's ravaged ecosystem, but Lessah was helping him just so she could advance her own standing. When a Republic-allied individual who was helping Senaru delivered the Arcona's scanner to her, they reprimanded her for her selfishness.

==Behind the scenes==
Representative Lessah was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. She appears in the Taris mission "Disease on a Distant World".
